confirmed.derivation: Three isolated RC sections behind ideal gain-10 buffers: poles -1/(RkCk) = -1e8, -8e8, -5e10 rad/s, no finite zeros. Linear MNA of the deck (numpy), sources zeroed: poles are the finite generalized eigenvalues of (G, -C); zeros those of the transfer system bordered by the input excitation and the output probe (scipy.linalg.eig). Xyce has no .pz.
